title: Exact polynomial byte-region integration diagnosis
objective: Diagnose and, if bounded to the exact-polynomial byte-region integration, correct huge rational polynomial evaluation and exact rational matrix minimal-polynomial equality without masking semantics

oracles: SageMath and Sage.js dynamic/native differential execution

handoff.summary: Correct two mathematically invalid expectations exposed when piped CLI failures began returning nonzero status. Sage.js native and native-disabled execution agree with SageMath: the skew integer polynomial evaluates to huge - 5/8 at 1/2, and a nontrivial size-two Jordan block contributes a squared factor to the minimal polynomial. Exact-polynomial byte-region ingress and coefficient storage were not implicated.
risks: The full rational-matrix polynomial test remains blocked on a separate compiler/runtime regression: blank-line-separated piped Python input loses its __main__ names after compiled module isolation.
next_steps: Repair persistent __main__ namespace semantics for piped multi-unit Python input, then rerun test/exact-rational-matrix-polynomials.cjs in both native modes.
